text:
incident-bot: ALERT: synthetic-canary/eu-auth latency spike >2000ms (5m). firing 3x. pager: #oncall. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/synthetics

alex: saw this. looks like the eu-auth probe 1s->2.2s across the last 5m. any customer-facing errors?

mira: Checking metrics now — 502s are not increasing, just latency in the HTTP health check. No error-rate spike in frontend logs.

sam: +1 on no user 5xxs. Could be probe contention or an infra noise window during autoscaler activity.

jordan: I can tail the probe logs. give me 30s.

ops-bot: runbook check: if latency only, consider silencing alerts, reduce probe rate, and collect p99 traces.

jordan: tail shows probes timing out at 2s threshold, but upstream app responded in 300-400ms when I replayed the request manually. Looks like intermittent scheduling latency on the probe runner node (k8s node eu-canary-3).

alex: ok, mitigation plan — 1) mute the firing alert to stop pages, 2) reduce synth frequency to 60s for eu region while we investigate, 3) add a 3x consecutive fail window to avoid flapping. Anyone object? :hand:

mira: agree. Do we want to adjust threshold instead of muting? I'm fine with frequency drop + consecutive window to avoid masking real issues.

sam: set the mute and scale frequency. I'll push a quick alert rule change and a note in incidents channel.

alex: action: sam will apply temporary alert change, jordan will cordon eu-canary-3 and restart canary pod, mira will open a follow-up to review probe runner scheduling and make a durable change to the probe config. I'll own customer comms if needed.

sam: updating alert rule now. snippet:```yaml
alert: SyntheticLatencyHigh
expr: increase( synthetic_latency_ms{region="eu",probe="eu-auth"}[5m]) > 2000
for: 15m # temp bump to avoid 1-2m noise
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/synthetics
```Applying with --dry-run first then apply.

alex: note: changed "for" to 3m + add a new label probe_owner=devex for quick routing.

jordan: cordoned node eu-canary-3 and restarted canary pod. pod came up healthy, initial probes back to 300-400ms.

mira: I've created ticket SNY-4123: "Investigate canary runner scheduling — eu-canary-3 preemptions causing probe timeouts" with steps and timeline. Assigned to eng-infra.

sam: alert changes deployed (temp): reduced firing frequency and added 3 consecutive failures window. I'll keep mute for 40m to let infra settle.

alex: reporting: no customer impact detected; internal dashboards show latency spike but no correlated user errors. We'll treat as synthesis noise and tune probes.

jordan: recommendation for postmortem tuning:
- increase probe timeout slightly to 3s to tolerate scheduling bursts
- add jittered interval to avoid synchronized spikes across nodes
- rely on aggregate error-rate alerts to page rather than single-probe latency
- new dashboard panel for probe runner node scheduling and CPU steal events

mira: also suggest we add a debounce rule in Alertmanager: require 2 distinct probe targets failing across region before firing P1. Keeps P2 for single-target noise.

alex: good. I'll take these into the post-incident action list. Tasks:
- SNY-4123 (eng-infra) investigate preemption / node pressure (mira)
- SNY-4124 (devex) update probe config: timeout -> 3s, jitter + randomized offset (sam)
- SNY-4125 (sre) create new dashboard and add probe-runner metrics (jordan)
- SNY-4126 (oncall) update runbook to include node-cordon steps and when to silence alerts (alex)

sam: added links to the edits in the alert repo and flagged them for review. PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/458

jordan: leaving a note for incoming oncall: I've cordoned node and left a comment in SNY-4123 with timestamps. If the next oncall sees repeated latency after 30m, escalate to eng-infra.

alex: incoming oncall @mira, handing off. Summary: probe noise, muted page, node cordoned & restarted, no customer errors, follow-ups created.

mira: taking handoff. I'll watch for 45m then hand to night oncall. If anything else fires, I'll escalate.

incident-bot: NOTE: thread marked resolved for now. Follow-ups created: SNY-4123,SNY-4124,SNY-4125,SNY-4126.

mira: quick retrospective notes: we should reduce probe density on single node (spread runners), move timeouts into per-region profiles, and add a synthetic-runner health alert that triggers before paging.

alex: agreed. We'll schedule a 30min post-incident sync with infra + devex to decide on thresholds and dashboard scope. I'll create the calendar invite. :calendar:
